mapper.select: SELECT id, overtime_code, employee_id, employee_name, overtime_date, start_time, end_time, overtime_hours, overtime_type, pay_rate, reason, approval_id, approval_status, approver_id, approver_name, approval_time, approval_remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_overtime WHERE deleted = 0 AND overtime_code = #{overtimeCode} LIMIT 1
